newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, gains in hoteliers.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, gains in hoteliers.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday with gains in some hoteliers and blue chips.
* Of 12 active issues five were up, six were down and one was unchanged.
* Top gainer was drug firm Pliva adding 48 kuna to 13,700 selling 284 shares.
* Biggest loser was hotelier Riviera Porec which last traded two weeks ago, 70 kuna down to 160 on volume of 463 shares.
* Most actively traded was Zagrebacka Banka which traded 3,655 units, edging down five kuna to 1,015 kuna. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
